newsitem.title: USA: Big Stone, 440 MW S.D. plant returns to service.
newsitem.headline: Big Stone, 440 MW S.D. plant returns to service.

text.p: The 440 megawatt (MW) Big Stone coal-fired power plant in Big Stone City, S.D. returned to service Sunday following scheduled maintenance, a Northwestern Public Service spokesman said Monday.
The plant, in northeast South Dakota near the Minnesota border, was shut Sept 5 for the maintenance.
It was ramping up towards full power as of Monday, spokesman Richard Green said.
Northwestern operates and holds a 23.4 percent interest in the plant, while Otter Tail Power Co holds 53.9 percent and Montana-Dakota Utilities Co holds the remaining 22.7 percent.
